title: My kitten seems to be enjoying the Leafs game
text: My kitten seems to be enjoying the leafs game @MapleLeafs https://t.co/BmRC3YRkEh
blurb: A gray tabby kitten has claimed a front-row seat to the Leafs game, paws planted on the TV stand and eyes locked on the action as Toronto plays Seattle. Their human seems to have a new hockey fan in the house.
